text: Silver conforms two differently-shaped sources — POS lines and online order events — into one unified sales_events table, at the grain fixed back in the kickoff.
Gold applies the star schema directly: one FactSales table at that fixed grain, surrounded by DimStore, DimProduct, and DimDate — the same shape reused across projects.
Stores change region and category mix over time, so DimStore needs history — the same SCD Type 2 pattern, implemented as a targeted MERGE, not a dimension rewrite.
Merging channels happens once, in silver, instead of being pushed into every query at gold or dashboard time — transform once, query many times.
A clean FactSales table, ready to query, with store history tracked properly. Next up: building the serving layer and the actual dashboard.
